decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud service shown on the home page and central to the firm's multichannel innovation direction, it is likely meeting strategic aspirations and worth continued support in a growing market.

It extends the firm's document workflow offer and had enough importance to receive its own page, so with industry growth and some organizational slack management would likely keep it while results mature.

Although only mentioned on the website, it builds on the firm's established messaging capabilities and serves regulated customers with legacy channel needs, making retention more likely than withdrawal.

As a close-in optimization feature for existing fax services, it likely requires limited extra resources and helps the installed base, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it absent clear failure.
Security is core to the firm's value proposition and this product strengthens compliant email services, so it is likely to remain on the market while the firm continues investing in innovation.
This feature closely complements the firm's secure messaging offer and likely benefits from shared infrastructure and R&D, reducing pressure to drop it within the next year.
